honesty: the TPU-listed versions are TRUNCATED — the ROMs carry 94.04.46.00.F0 and 94.04.25.40.C5 where TPU lists .F and .C (the version-string trap, GPU edition)
sha256 conventions here are FULL sha256 + sha256_16 (first 16 hex); the BIOS- lab's BODY0x40000 convention has no GPU equivalent yet
subsystem 1462:3904 does NOT name the retail model by itself — the board models above come from the TPU entries, to be confirmed against the live dump
